items.text: Uku ndiko kuropafadza kwaMozisi munhu waMwari kwaakataura kuvaIsraeri asati afa.
Akauya nezviuru gumi zvavatsvene kubva rutivi rwezasi,
uye vanhu vake ngavarege kuva vashoma."
Uye izvi ndizvo zvaakataura pamusoro paJudha:
Haiwa, ivai mubatsiri wake pavavengi vake!"
Ropafadzai kubata kwake kwose, imi Jehovha,
uye regai uyo anodikanwa naJehovha agare pakati pamapfudzi ake."
uye nenyasha dzake iye anogara mugwenzi rinopfuta.
Zvipfigiso zvemasuo ako zvichava zvesimbi nendarira,
uye simba rako richafanana namazuva ako.
Mwari anogara nokusingaperi ndiye utiziro hwako,
uye pasi pake pane maoko anogara nokusingaperi.
Achadzinga vavengi vako kubva pamberi pako,
uye iwe uchatsika-tsika nzvimbo dzavo dzakakwirira."
